hard_gates: AI observability may collect only explicitly governed fields at approved sampling, retention, region, and access; prompt, response, tool, user, or retrieved content is denied by default.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.

APM enablement requires a single known instrumentation path, exact service and environment identity, compatibility and overhead checks, governed telemetry, and rollback; duplicate instrumentation blocks change.
Troubleshooting is read-only: it cannot install agents, change sampling or tags, restart services, remap identity, or claim a fix from diagnosis alone.
Logs deny secret and sensitive fields by default and require exact source, parsing, routing, retention, access, deletion, volume, and cost boundaries before provider mutation.
An alert requires an actionable owner, justified threshold and window, missing-data behavior, deduplication, runbook, validation, and rollback; alert volume alone is not coverage.

Agent installation requires a pinned verified artifact, exact targets, least privilege, governed telemetry, resource and network bounds, health evidence, and uninstall or rollback; mutable latest and duplicate agents are blocked.
Release observability requires exact immutable release, commit, artifact, service, and environment identities; association does not prove deployment or authorize provider actions beyond the mapping.

responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 7 related modes: Configure one provider's AI or LLM observability for exact applications and environments under explicit telemetry governance and per-action authorization.; Enable one approved APM instrumentation variant for exact services and environments without duplicate agents or manual instrumentation under per-action authorization.; Diagnose missing, duplicate, malformed, or misidentified APM signals from read-only platform evidence and route fixes to authorized enablement or installation owners.; Configure one provider's log collection, parsing, routing, retention, access, and sensitive-data controls for exact services and environments under per-action authorization.; Create or update exact provider monitors and alert routes from approved SLOs, thresholds, windows, severity, ownership, and noise controls under per-action authorization.; Install one approved observability agent variant on exact hosts or cluster scope with pinned artifact, least privilege, governed data, health, and rollback under per-action authorization.; Configure one provider's release and commit association for exact services and environments under per-action authorization without deploying or changing source.
